extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat
extraction.description: A suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. The suite includes three specialized models (arabic-small-nougat, arabic-base-nougat, arabic-large-nougat) fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset (arabic-img2md) of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. Key innovations include the Aranizer-PBE-86k tokenizer, torch.bfloat16 precision, and Flash Attention 2 for efficient training and inference.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.publisher: Faculty of Engineering Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt
extraction.citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad. (2024). Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835v1 [cs.CL].
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset (arabic-img2md) was created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. A large-scale dataset (arabic-books) of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens was extracted from over 8,500 books using the SOTA model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from Hindawi website, PDFs, and extracted Markdown text for arabic-img2md dataset. Arabic books for arabic-books dataset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content was converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted. The arabic-books dataset was extracted using the SOTA model from over 8,500 books.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The arabic-img2md dataset consists of paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, which serve as annotations/labels for training the OCR models.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Aranizer-PBE-86k tokenizer, torch.bfloat16 precision, Flash Attention 2
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All models and datasets are open-sourced. The implementation is available at https://github.com/MohamedAliRashad/arabic-nougat.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Hallucination in arabic-small-nougat, repetition issues in larger models, dataset biases (limited to Hindawi content), scalability challenges, cross-script generalization not tested, and difficulties with complex layouts (e.g., dense tables, charts).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, and Validation for Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction tasks. Recommended use: arabic-base-nougat for general text extraction and arabic-large-nougat for lengthy or complex documents.
